bluf: Two people were killed and dozens wounded in Russian strikes on Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia overnight. GDACS reported a magnitude 6.4 earthquake in the Mauritius-Reunion Region at 11:06 UTC.

disasters.text: GDACS reported a magnitude 6.4 earthquake at a depth of 10 km in the Mauritius-Reunion Region at 11:06 UTC; potential impacts were listed as unknown.

items.text: Russian strikes killed two people and wounded dozens in Zaporizhzhia overnight, according to France 24; Reuters also reported at least two killed and dozens injured.
The Guardian World reported that a Russian drone violated Polish airspace; the report did not state when this occurred.

France 24 reported that NATO chief Mark Rutte said the alliance would defend against threats in space, responding to German media reports that Russia may be preparing to launch a nuclear-armed satellite.

Sheikh Hasina said she plans to return to Bangladesh on December 16; Al Jazeera reported that she urged Dhaka to arrange her return on the national airline, while the government said she can only be extradited.
